time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; frame for time t = round(t * fps)
units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (background identical across frames; no pan/shake detected; composite background from frame 0 left half + frame 90 right half shows no seams)
camera.view: frontal street view: optical axis ~perpendicular to the building wall; wall horizontals stay horizontal; lamp poles nearly vertical (lean of ~2-3 px over 180 rows, converging slightly downward => camera pitch ~0, at most slightly down)
camera.horizon_estimate_y: ~540 (image centre) if the camera is level - not directly observable; no vanishing point in view
camera.perspective_cues: Both cars drive parallel to the image plane at constant depth (ground-contact rows constant: orange 794, black 900). Apparent side-profile sizes are constant over time (orange wheelbase 323.2 px everywhere it is measured). But wide-angle perspective is visible: when a car is right of the image centre its front face is visible (apparent front extends ~70-80 px further left than the side profile), when left of centre its rear face is visible (apparent rear extends up to ~100+ px further right). Black car (near lane) is closer to the camera than the orange car (far lane, at the curb).
camera.focal_length: unknown; estimate from depth_info if given
